meta.method: Playwright + local Edge (tools/shot.py). Mobile = 390x844 iPhone UA, cs-CZ; m1 = raw first screen at 2.5 s (cookie banner as a visitor sees it); m-full = after --consent (privacy-preserving button when found), scrolled, clipped to 6000 CSS px; d1 = 1440x900 desktop. Page weight = bytes transferred + request count on a mobile load before any consent (headless, local broadband, so LCP is only a relative signal). Cookie coverage = % of the mobile first screen covered by the consent panel (visual estimate cross-checked with grid sampling); 'dims_page' = a full-screen backdrop blocks the page. No form was submitted, no account created, no login; post-submit experience comes from the page's own copy/FAQ only.
notes: Bankovnipoplatky.com is now a parked domain (Rozhled.cz placeholder); bankovnipoplatky.cz is a bank-news site with no ETF lead gen. Listed under light entries only.

Lynx CZ: no Czech ETF e-book found on lynxbroker.cz (education hub, sitemaps and ETF guide checked). Its Czech education = articles, webinars and newsletters (Breakout Trader, Týdenní přehled). Free e-books/info packs are a Lynx tactic in other markets (e.g. lynxbroker.pl per public press), not in CZ today.
Trading 212 desktop returned 'Access Denied' and Revolut desktop returned a Cloudflare human check (not bypassed). Their mobile pages rendered and were captured.
Desktop/mobile LCP values are from a local fast connection; treat 'heavy' pages as 2-4x slower on real mobile 4G.

takeaways: Nobody advertises a US-ETF vs UCITS comparison or an ETF cheat sheet in CZ – the 'ETF' ad space is broker funnels (XTB) and advisor call funnels.
XTB is the volume player and tests education hooks (real-estate vs ETF dilemma, 8-video course) rather than 'ETF list' hooks.
Creators use comment-to-DM and webinars; advisors target people with 1–30 M Kč already invested ('skládanka bez strategie').
Message mismatch is common (ad promises e-book, lands on homepage or instant form).
